name: Anna Stürgkh - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on electricity grids: the backbone of the EU energy system
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking for a major upgrade of Europe's electricity grids. It wants more cross-border power links, faster permits for new lines, and more money for cables and local networks. It also wants clearer rules on who gets connected first, better protection against cyberattacks and sabotage, and training for the workers needed. This is a set of recommendations, not a new law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks the Commission and member states to act, including a possible revision of grid rules.
- **Who it affects:** Electricity grid operators, energy companies, households and businesses paying grid fees.
- **What happens next:** The Commission is asked to propose changes, such as a binding 2036 cross-border target by June 2026.
